command.runtime_shift: 0..17; computed by real U/E normalizer for K128 and committed before EXEC; native head's eight K16 groups share this one runtime A shift but retain eight independent FP16 W scales/RNEs
command.framing: SOP exactly word0; EOP exactly word(length-1), where the sole permitted per-op length is lengths[opcode]; malformed frame yields one held fault

BEGIN_SCOPE.word0: short_header, bank=0, high16=0; scope_generation must advance exactly once

CONTEXT_SHORT.word0: short_header; bank=0, high16 low3 is CREATE0/SPILL3/DROP4; remaining13 bits zero; result ticket=session

RESTORE.word2: target RF owner128, must equal cached scope owner
RESTORE.words5_6: actual S32 previous snapshot fetched through two real S128 reads

CANCEL_INPUT.word0: short_header; bank bits28:29, bank_generation high16; scope-generation and record must match live Wdescriptor

DRAIN_INPUT.word0: same target layout as CANCEL; waits actual issued returns and raw/A drain

FENCE_TRANSPORT.word0: short_header; only session nonzero, record/scope/scope_generation/bank/high16 all zero; matching real MC purge then response

command.identity: BEGIN key128 names input X/state job-object version; owner128 names distinct output projection/RF owner. gate/up can share key while having different owner. EXEC session maps cached key plus record, A_slot/generation,kk,use and shift; same X tile may be replayed under different gate/up sessions without aliasing RF owners.

response.framing: SOP word0; length encoded flags[15:12]; EOP exactly last declared word; source ACK only on actual EOP acceptance
response.RF_word2_word3: actual S32x8 only for FINAL/SPILL; RF-only continue/control/error uses two-word identity+metadata response and exposes no bogus S store data
response.session_rule: LC finite descriptor owner resolves session+record+ticket to full job/object/RF owner; do not reuse a session until its frames, A lease and guard ACKs are drained; rollover requires coordinated epoch fence
response.snapshot_ACK: RF FINAL/SPILL EOP captures into a reserved entry of external 2x32B guard; two separate true 128-bit S write ACKs commit the snapshot; RESTORE must match full owner/context/ticket/offset/fullK/group/n and actual guard commit

event_payloads.RF_RECORD: 2word identity/meta for continue/control/error; 4words for FINAL/SPILL with actual S32 data
event_payloads.ABORT: 4words: header; context/actual-nextK; full input key128; full RFowner128
event_payloads.FAULT: 3words: header; event-specific reason/bank/gen; full bad key128

unowned_transport_fault.events: FAULT event7 status13 MC return,14 fence done,15 A stream
unowned_transport_fault.header: session=0, record=0, full bad key word2=0; never attribute to current bank/A owner
unowned_transport_fault.LC_policy: bounded global transport diagnostic; do not complete or cancel a live guard command by current bank index

A.handshake: ready/valid; one true K16 beat per cycle; session resolves key/record/slot/gen/kk/use; no 128-bit serialization of A
A.input_lease_release: INPUT_CONSUMED response EOP after all eight true operand accepts
A.offer_rule: Only offer a session after its complete matching EXEC frame EOP was accepted. The bounded EXEC dispatch wait deasserts A ready until native binding; unknown/stale sessions produce a bounded fault without M/W consumption.

DMA.credits: 32 per M as an upper bound; real MC has two independent channels, each 32 outstanding beats and 32 descriptors; actual request ready applies all global bounds
DMA.ordering: record beats issue sequentially, records may interleave, returns may reorder; valid request is held stable; no phantom MC acceptance
DMA.late_return: must match transport epoch+bank+generation+issued unseen beat; duplicate/stale produces a bounded fault without overwriting data or refunding credit
DMA.wrap: bank-generation reuse at 65536 requires a completed matching actual MC FENCE purge before a new transport epoch; epoch wrap also requires the purge; never infer safety merely from outstanding=0

partial_close.tag_base: epoch9/bank2/generation16/zero5; same descriptor identity as beat tags
partial_close.normal_record: last true source request of 17/18 closes issue set implicitly
partial_close.cancel: after all held requests accepted, no more requests permitted, and at least one issued beat: stable CLOSE until MC ready atomically registers no-more-issue
partial_close.drain: last issued return alone cannot retire; wait actual CLOSE accept and all issued returns; zero-issued cancel has no global descriptor to close
partial_close.charged_state: table_closed4 + close_locked1 + locked_close_bank2 and decode; three real physical port signals (34bits)

finite_state_budget.native_RF_response_metadata_fields: from_raw1,last_group1,kind3,ticket32; pointers2+2/count3 are additional; matches every real RF command/response, required for finite II1 head pipeline
finite_state_budget.W_descriptor_fields: full key128, record32, generation16, base64, epoch9, allocation-session32, head/n, issued/received bitmaps18 each, cancellation/issue cursor
finite_state_budget.external_result_guard: actual independent 2x32B; no hidden extra result queue or SRAM
finite_state_budget.physical_accounting: all frames, tables, register data, combinational decode/mux and clock logic count in M; no copied physical success receipt
finite_state_budget.scope_fields: per RF context: valid1,generation16,key128,owner128,fullK16,n4,head1,bias256 =550 bits; BEGIN_SCOPE is amortized across that output projection K128 records
finite_state_budget.global_range_credits: Independent LC range6 issued-ticket metadata candidate; W4, RF16, M1exec and external guard2 capacities stay distinct. An INPUT ACK releases a W bank only; it does not retire a FINAL/SPILL range ticket before true S ACK.

capabilities.dynamic_S32xS32_QK_AV: unsupported; no inherited old M coverage
capabilities.attention_decomposition_candidate: UNIMPLEMENTED/UNREGISTERED: signed32 A can use three balanced signed16 digits at radix 2^15; signed32 W can use five balanced signed8 digits at radix 2^7. This gives 15 A16xW8 partial dot passes, followed by exact shifted recombination. Worst-case K128 S32xS32 sum needs 71 signed bits, so current S32 RF alone cannot implement exact recombination; wider accumulator/format or a separately verified quantized numeric profile is necessary. No old dynamic32 timing/physical claim transfers.

history_note: ABI 0x02504d01 fixed8 sketch was never a product implementation and is intentionally absent from this machine contract
